name: Nantuko Cultivator
oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may discard any number of land cards. Put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature and draw that many cards.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, you may discard any number of land cards. Put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature and draw that many cards.

needs.what: a `selector` (card filter over the discarding player's hand, here `{"types": ["Land"]}`) on the `discard` effect op, so a resolving trigger can say "you may discard any number of land cards": only matching cards are offered, any number from 0 up to the matching cards in hand (`up_to` with a ceiling counted over the filtered hand), discarded simultaneously as one event and recorded by `as`, so the following `add_counters` and `draw` read `{"count": {"binding": ...}}` for "that many"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: op_discard takes only amount, as, player, random, up_to and whole_hand and offers the whole hand to `ask_objects`, so a nonland card could be discarded and counted. The cost route fails too: `may` with `pay: {discard_x, discard_selector: Land}` and `x` announces X through `_announce_x`, which bounds it by `max_affordable_x` over the mana cost only, and with no {X} in the mana that returns 0, so X is always 0. A `may` + `repeat` loop paying `discard: 1` with a land `discard_selector` and drawing each time interleaves the draws with the discards (lands drawn mid-loop could then be discarded, and it is separate discard events), and reading the draw count off `counters_on` self is wrong when a counter replacement doubles the counters or the creature has left the battlefield.
